question: On one frozen standard-retail Shanghai/Shenzhen main-board universe, which completed 1h latest-endpoint and recent session-4h windows produce LONG proposals under the unchanged Grade-A YOLO detector and unchanged causal semantic gate?

owner_authorization.verbatim: 给我跑 4h  1h 周期的  只保留多头，  4h 周期可以接受信号已经出来几天的
owner_authorization.interpreted_action: Run the already frozen detector on completed A-share 1h bars and on completed session-aware 4h bars, retain only LONG semantic survivors for delivery, and allow the 4h scan to look back over the last five complete trading days.

single_variable_bundle: Owner explicitly requested two inference timeframes together. For each configuration, change only the inference timeframe and endpoint policy relative to the preceding A-share 15m snapshot. Checkpoint, renderer, image size, W18/W19, confidence, NMS, structural mapping and semantic thresholds remain fixed. The 1h and 4h results are reported separately and are not used to tune one another.

library_reference.note: The scan uses the documented AKShare 60-minute request shape with the repository's pinned requests/pandas stack. Eastmoney does not publish a supported public API contract for this endpoint, so returned field semantics and availability remain an explicit upstream limitation.

universe.rule: Keep only SH_MAIN and SZ_MAIN identities; exclude STAR, ChiNext, BSE, unknown boards, ST/*ST/S*ST/SST, PT and names containing the delisting marker 退.
universe.note: This is a conservative board/name eligibility screen for a basic mainland cash-equity account, not proof that a specific broker account can fill an order. Suspensions and stale histories are removed by schedule checks.

bars.raw_timestamp_semantics: Expected to be 60-minute bar-close labels. Retained labels must be exactly one of 10:30, 11:30, 14:00 and 15:00 Asia/Shanghai. The source row open_time is its close-label minus one hour.
bars.reference_schedule: SSE Composite secid=1.000001 from the same endpoint and freeze, unadjusted
bars.eligibility_1h: Latest close-label must equal 2026-09-02 14:00 CST and the trailing 160 1h close-labels must exactly match the reference schedule.
bars.eligibility_4h: One session-aware 4h bar is exactly four same-date 60m rows at 10:30, 11:30, 14:00 and 15:00 CST, with open=09:30, close/available_at=15:00 and OHLCV aggregated in order. The latest 160 complete session bars must exactly match reference dates through 2026-09-01. Incomplete 2026-09-02 is excluded.
bars.snapshot_gate: Fail closed unless each timeframe has at least 80% coverage of the 3,111-name frozen universe and same-source network failures do not exceed max(10, 1% of the universe). No alternate provider is allowed after the result is visible.
bars.corporate_action_note: QFQ is frozen for this snapshot. Future corporate actions can revise historical QFQ values, so the saved CSV bytes are the reproducibility authority.

source_contract.phase_separation: Write the holdout-consumption-start ledger before the first current-bar network request; freeze all 60m CSV bytes before loading the model. Scan and verification phases perform zero network reads.

model_contract.name: Grade-A 8k positives + 24k negatives, full40, native 1280
model_contract.feature_causality: For each endpoint, add_candidate_features uses only OHLCV rows at or before that endpoint; W18/W19 render only those trailing bars. No later bar enters the model image or semantic gate.

semantic_gate_contract.reuse: Apply the exact accepted completed-history causal-prefix gate without threshold grids or post-result changes.
semantic_gate_contract.direction_flip_null: For each structurally legal proposal, hold box/time/confidence fixed and recompute the gate with LONG and SHORT inverted. Report actual and flipped survival as a semantic-direction null, not a return test.

delivery_contract.audit: Run and count both detector classes internally. Do not render or deliver SHORT charts; retain SHORT audit rows and counts so direction filtering is inspectable.
delivery_contract.identifier: Every delivered row and chart must include the six-digit code and venue-qualified search key SHxxxxxx or SZxxxxxx.
delivery_contract.four_hour_age: Scan exactly the last five complete reference trading-day endpoints through 2026-09-01. Deduplicate detections within the frozen five-bar same-symbol gap and report first/latest availability.
delivery_contract.zero_survivor_rule: Report zero honestly and produce a zero-result overview. Do not lower confidence, semantic thresholds, board filters or history requirements.

decision_and_reporting.economic_metrics: Not applicable: this is an OOD detection snapshot without future A-share outcome labels, execution simulation, matched random entries or owner-confirmed A-share Gold. Use the frozen direction-flip semantic null as the non-directional control.

reasons: The checkpoint was trained on crypto 15-minute charts, not A shares or 1h/4h charts.
Changing timeframe changes candle-shape and moving-average distributions; these are research proposals, not validated trade signals.
A shares have session breaks, price limits, corporate actions and different volatility/microstructure.
The detector requires 2-9 post-core confirmation bars, so all survivors are completed-history proposals rather than fresh onset signals.
risk_contract.language: Call outputs OOD research proposals or model hits, never recommendations or profit probabilities.
